post.description: Send email, password, and a device name. There is no public registration endpoint. Browser clients use the session login instead.
post.summary: Sign in and create a mobile API token

get.description: Returns the account and its locale/time-zone settings. Requires a valid Sanctum token or browser session.

post.description: Only the token used for this request is revoked; other devices stay signed in.
post.summary: Revoke the current mobile API token

get.description: Pass a required YYYY-MM-DD date. Results include immutable ingredient and nutrition snapshots for that user's day.
get.summary: List meals logged on a local date

post.description: Supply a category, eaten_at timestamp with offset, and either recipe_id plus servings or an items array. Nutrition is snapshotted from Hustle Daily foods, never HealthKit. Send an Idempotency-Key header.
post.summary: Log a meal from a recipe or individual foods

examples: Idempotency key was already used with different data.

get.description: Returns up to 31 recent dates, or every logged date in the requested YYYY-MM month, with meal count and consumed calorie/protein totals for the signed-in user.
get.summary: List recent dates with logged food

patch.description: Change its category or notes, or replace ingredients to recalculate nutrition. The correction keeps an audit revision. Send an Idempotency-Key header.
patch.summary: Correct one of your logged meals

examples: Idempotency key was already used with different data.

delete.summary: Remove a logged meal from daily totals while retaining its correction history

get.summary: Show the selected day's food totals and effective targets
get.description: Returns the authenticated user's dated meal snapshots and their recalculated totals. Health data is unavailable until synchronization is implemented.
Returns its name, platform, and last-seen time. Another user's device is not visible.
get.summary: Get one of your registered devices

get.description: The optional query searches names and brands; at most 30 active foods are returned. This does not call Open Food Facts.

post.description: Nutrition uses an explicit g, ml, or serving basis. Household portions require food-specific conversions; density is never guessed. Send an Idempotency-Key header for safe retries.

examples: Idempotency key was already used with different data.

get.description: Foods belonging to another account are not visible.
get.summary: Get a branded food with nutrition and portions

patch.description: Replace its nutrition and explicit portions. Existing meal snapshots are not changed. A portion used by a recipe cannot be removed. Send an Idempotency-Key header for safe retries.
patch.summary: Update one of your branded foods

get.description: Creates the default categories for this account on first access, then returns them in display order.
Includes each recipe's branded ingredients and portion definitions.

post.description: Supply a name, yield in servings, and one or more branded ingredients with exact units or food-specific portions. Send an Idempotency-Key header.

examples: Idempotency key was already used with different data.

get.description: Returns the recipe and its ingredient details; other users' recipes are not visible.
get.summary: Get one of your ready meals

patch.description: Replaces the ingredient list using your branded foods and their explicit portions. Previously logged meals keep their immutable snapshots. Send an Idempotency-Key header.

get.description: Today is based on the user's time zone. This phase reports consumed nutrition only; health data is not yet synchronized.
get.summary: Show today's food totals and logged meals

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
